narration: You arrive without remembering how. Beneath your boots is a floor of dark, glassy stone, cool and faintly humming, as though something vast breathes far below it. Where you step, thin threads of pale blue light spread outward and fade, like ripples on black water. Far to the north, low on the horizon, a single white light hangs unmoving. It is not a star. It seems to be waiting for you to notice it.

facts.description: A limitless flat plain of dark, glassy obsidian-like stone, polished smooth with faint hairline veins. Where it is touched, thin pale blue light ripples outward in rings and fades after a few seconds. A low mist clings a few centimeters above the surface.
facts.placement: Underfoot, extending in all directions from the Wanderer at [0,0,0] to the horizon.

facts.description: A single steady white light, small and sharp, glowing low on the horizon like a lantern or a fallen star. It casts a faint long reflection down the glassy plain toward the Wanderer.
facts.placement: About 2 km due north of the Wanderer, at ground level on the horizon.
